record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare HELPING_HAND: Sentret (1 star, maxPP 100) and Furret (2 stars, maxPP 80); both range 1, no passive. The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star index into the shield table, maxPP and stats.
record.summary: Needs no target. The two allies (same team, not the caster) closest to the caster by Manhattan distance anywhere on the board each receive (1) the marker effect DOUBLE_DAMAGE and (2) a shield: requested 30 (1 star) / 60 (2 stars) / 100 / 200 raw. The shield is applied through PokemonEntity.addShield: the receiving ally's Big Eater Belt scales the raw value first (x1.25, rounded down), then PokemonState.addShield multiplies by (1 + caster AP/100) (apBoost 1) and by the caster's full critPower on a crit, halves it if the receiver is enraged, rounds, and adds it to the receiver's current shield; it does nothing for a receiver with hp <= 0. DOUBLE_DAMAGE is a set marker: the only reader in the tree is handleSpecialDamage, where an attacker carrying it doubles that call's special damage and loses the marker; the marker is not removed by a timer in this strategy. With fewer than two other allies, only those that exist are buffed; with none, nothing happens (the PP is still spent). The caster itself is never buffed.

targeting.who: up to two allies of the caster's team (excluding the caster) with the smallest Manhattan distance to the caster, regardless of range
targeting.note: Allies are collected by a row-major scan of the board (y outer, x inner) and sorted ascending by distance; JavaScript's stable sort therefore breaks equal distances by that scan order (lower y first, then lower x). Whether benched or dead units appear in board cells was not examined; the board scan covers entities on the board.

geometry.shape: two nearest allies by Manhattan distance (|dx| + |dy|), no area

effects.target: each of the two nearest allies
effects.scaling: REQUESTED = raw table value (30 / 60). APPLIED per ally: Math.round(floor-rounded(raw x 1.25 if the receiving ally holds a Big Eater Belt) x (1 + caster AP/100) x (caster critPower if the cast crit) x 0.5 if the receiver is enraged), added to the receiver's shield. The Big Eater Belt is the receiver's, not the caster's. The crit flag is rolled only if the caster has ABILITY_CRIT.
effects.resolution: requested raw -> receiver belt (rounded down) -> AP -> crit -> enraged -> round -> shield + value; skipped if the receiver's hp is 0 or less. The caster's shieldDone statistic grows by the applied amount.

effects.target: each of the two nearest allies
effects.scaling: no numeric scaling in the strategy; the marker is added before the shield, and adding it twice has no extra effect (it is a set).
effects.resolution: consumed by the holder's next handleSpecialDamage call as attacker that is not blocked by protect / skydiving / Magic Bounce on the target (the guard returns before the marker is read): that call's special damage is multiplied by 2 after the AP boost; other damage types and handleDamage callers do not read it.

buffs.permanentInFight: until consumed by a special damage call; no timer in this strategy

starBehavior.note: table index is the casting entity's stars; 100 and 200 are not reached at the factory star counts of these units. Sentret has maxPP 100 and Furret 80 in the unit blocks. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Targets are chosen by distance from the caster at cast time; no range limit. Equal distances are resolved by board scan order.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state. Shields add to the current shield; a re-marked ally keeps a single DOUBLE_DAMAGE marker (set).
record.rawVsResolved: Requested shield: 30 (Sentret) / 60 (Furret) per ally. Applied: the receiver's Big Eater Belt x1.25 rounded down on the raw value, then x (1 + caster AP/100), x critPower on crit, x0.5 if enraged, rounded. Not applied to a receiver with hp <= 0. DOUBLE_DAMAGE is a marker with no number of its own; its x2 applies to the next unblocked special damage of the holder.
